'''Vu Nin''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] trooper native to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], but she was off the planet when it was destroyed by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. When she heard about the destruction of her homeworld, she applied for a position in the Special Forces team. She completed her training as an Infiltrator and requested a transfer to the [[Alderaanian Death Legion]]. Instead, she was assigned to [[Taskforce Shen]]. She was eventually promoted to First Lieutenant, acting as [[Mart Stevez]]'s second in command.
